Known for great steaks and excellent service.
No regrets when dining here.
I also feel that giving a review isn't really needed since their food and service speak for themselves.
Also, parking here isn't bad either because finding good parking is rare.

We have been to several Ruth's locations and the Downtown Indianapolis location, is above and beyond! From the moment you park your car (I recommend using their amazing Valet) you will be met by friendly hosts and restaurant staff. Consistently perfectly cooked steaks, welcoming and accommodating serving staff, and an amazing date night vibe. Our favorite spot to hit for a casual night out or fancy dinner!

We don't have this restaurant where we live and always get to go to Ruth Chris when we added in town.  The food and service are always top-notch.  The restaurant itself, not so much. The chairs are worn (see photo), the carpet is faded, and the bathrooms are disgusting. Take some pride in the appearance of the restaurant.

I ordered online to have order delivered.  Order never arrived.   I was told by a manager,  not Cheddars fault so sorry.   No refund. No food.  Is Uber eats fault.  Cheddars billed my account,  Cheddars engaged Uber.  But too bad for me.   No customer service.   No recourse.   🤨

This place was to die for!! The food, the atmosphere, the music, the ambiance, everything was superb! We had a wonderful server who notified us all of the specials going on and even helped us take some pictures at the end of the evening. The place also offers valet parking, which is nice for those who don't want to find self-parking. If in the area, come to this location!!

Black lady at the front right when you walked in didn’t even greet us than when I greeted her she replied we can’t come in because of a dress code policy. She said it’s on the website but I booked through open glass and didn’t see that. CAPITAL GRILL , I will not recommend you to ANYONE. The white people didn’t even say anything but the lady with the same color skin as me did. My boyfriend went in before me and she didn’t greet me or him
Outstanding steaks. Service was very personable and attentive. Really enjoyed the location close but not on the beach. Easy parking.

FALSE ADVERTISEMENT!!! ON OUR WAY BACK TO SAN ANTONIO AND STOPPED IN KATY ONLY TO GO TO A GAS STATION FOR THIS PLACE. ITS LOCATED INSIDE OF A GAS STATION AND AT 2PM AIN'T EVEN NO FOOD COOKING!!!! THESE PLACES SHOULD HAVE TO STATE ON THE WEBSITE THAT THEY ARE LOCATED IN A GAS STATION. THIS IS SOME BS!!!! I ONLY PUT 1 STAR BECAUSE THERE IS NOT AN OPTION FOR ZERO.

Ordered from Seamless, Doordash delivered. I am always worried about 3rd party delivery services like Uber Eats but our Dasher was awesome. Food was delivered as intended. Bareburger packed it super neat, wish the meals were marked but not a huge deal. All of the burgers were cooked perfectly, the fries were fresh and tasty. Would definitely order again.

Went to Ruth’s Chris for Mother’s Day and, as always, it was a wonderful experience. Everything from the appetizers to the dessert was absolutely delicious. I had the stuffed chicken, and it’s a 10/10, highly recommend if you’re not sure what to order. You really can’t go wrong with it! Our server, Ryan, made the evening even better. He was attentive, friendly, and had a great eye for detail.

Realized I never reviewed this place when I came about 6 years ago. But I came alone and recall the food and service being good. I had just bought a brand new Porsche and opted in for valet. Valet driver was really young and was able to hear him having fun with it in the parking garage across the street with my new exhaust system that was echoing out haha.

Order online. Waited 20 mins more than est wait time. They put chips in a box with chicken, which is weird, but no big deal. The big deal is everything but the bread was cold. Went to let one of the take out people know all they did was microwave it. Now why would I want microwaved food when I came to a scratch kitchen. Called to speak with manager and was put in hold. Waited and waited.. no big deal maybe they are busy… until the person that answered the phone acted like it was my first time calling and never got the manager. I gave up after that. Disputed

The valet guy on Sunday & Monday is phenomenal, it is complimentary to valet park right up front outside the restaurant! he will safely guard and handle your vehicle with utmost respect and care during your stay, in hopes of earning a well deserved and generous tip. Make sure to come by exclusively on Sunday or Monday for this unparalleled valet experience!

Need a break from the monotony? Try Capital Grille. The service is always top-notch. And the food?? Superb. It's a romantic place. Lots of proposals happens here. 😆

Valet and lot parking available. Accessible parking and entrance.
Great food, great service and great atmosphere. I was only skeptic of parking, but valet is a life saver. This has turned in to one of our go to places in Denver.
Wonderful service from all staff, valet/front desk/server.  Food was excellent and acknowledgement from the whole staff on our anniversary was a great touch, thanks for a wonderful evening.
Wonderful service from all staff, valet/front desk/server.  Food was excellent and acknowledgement from the whole staff on our anniversary was a great touch, thanks for a wonderful evening.

I come to this location quite often since I live down the block from it. Most of the time I just do pick up, unless i'm with friends. The food is always good and the workers most of the time are super nice. Except for tonight, the hostess/ waitress was very sweet, she told me to wait at the bar till my food was ready, so I did. The bartender was not as sweet, and was actually quite rude and told me to wait outside. I then had to wait 7 minutes after the app said it was ready for pickup. To say I was annoyed, upset, and frankly disappointed would be an understaitment.

The whole experience is really top notch. Just drop the car at the valet and everyone knows who you are and why you’re there. My wife and I came for our anniversary, and all of the staff told up happy anniversary as they stopped by. The food, yall THE FOOD. My wife got the filet and I got the NY strip. I’ve paid way more for steak that wasn’t half as good. By the time you get the bill the meal feels like a bargain.
I placed my order online. I received friendly customer service, but my ordered was screwed up. I paid for extra garlic shrimp sauce and did not receive one of my side items.

Great food, service, prices, parking. We had honey buttered croissants, chicken pot pie, country fried steak, beer battered fish and shrimp, chicken fingers, a variety of veggies. For dessert, we had the carrot cake, the chocolate cake both were delicious. We ate here 3 nights in a row. Wish we had a Cheddar Scratch Kitchen here in SC!

First time experience was great. The calamari appetizer was delicious as well as the lollipop lamb chops.  Our steaks were cooked perfectly.  The birthday dessert was a treat.  Our server, Krissy, was spot-on and the valet service was excellant!  Definitely will be returning.

Don’t go. They have valet parking that’s $10. Worse, the valet is beyond rude. Restaurant management needs to do something about this valet is their first and last impression. The guy who worked there today during the daytime should be fired immediately.

When I did a quick review I really cannot answer the questions because that was the first time I've been there I did not go inside I had curbside service but the food was excellent and the server was very friendly
Good, not the best Experience at a Ruth’s. We valet the car and the guy was a jerk. Hey dude your tip is to be nice or leave .this is a high end hotel/restaurant so act accordingly.
Good, not the best Experience at a Ruth’s. We valet the car and the guy was a jerk. Hey dude your tip is to be nice or leave .this is a high end hotel/restaurant so act accordingly.

I took my wife here for her birthday. The Staff was very friendly and our server Kat was great. Even on our way out the door we got a thank you from everyone including the Valet staff.  Saying the food was incredible would be an understatement and my wife and I would highly recommend Ruth's Chris.

The waitress was very nice. The food was delicious from the appetizes to the main course.  The honey butter rolls melted in my mouth.  The baby back ribs were just as the menu stated. Enjoyed everything!

We went there to celebrate 2 birthdays and they made so all feel very special from the hostess with the mostest Knesha and to our awesome waiter Justin and the wonderful manager Tric. We all had the delicious sizzling petite filets, but the highlight of the whole meal was the amazing sweet potato casserole!!!! At the end of the night we were met at the door by the top notch valet Antonio !!! We will be looking forward to another great meal at the Asheville Ruth's Chris.

We went there to celebrate 2 birthdays and they made so all feel very special from the hostess with the mostest Knesha and to our awesome waiter Justin and the wonderful manager Tric. We all had the delicious sizzling petite filets, but the highlight of the whole meal was the amazing sweet potato casserole!!!! At the end of the night we were met at the door by the top notch valet Antonio !!! We will be looking forward to another great meal at the Asheville Ruth's Chris.

Excellent fine dining steakhouse with upscale atmosphere. Worth an occasional splurge, because prices are quite high. Parking is not easy; you need to pay for valet, or find a nearby (expensive) garage.

Very good veggie burger with the black bean, very good shakes, great onion rings with the asiago truffle and overall flexible options. It's a bit pricey but the food is good. You'de better off ordering for delivery because it's extremely hard to find parking space.

You can reserve your table online and 6th street is open so it’s easier to take an uber or drive up to the restaurant for parking. The staff is wonderful and the food is delicious. Perfect spot for intimate birthdays.

Ordered food online. If Texas Roadhouse and Cracker Barrel had a baby, it would be Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen. Everything we ordered was great. Chicken Tenders with fries, the sirloin and half rack of ribs, and the salmon with grilled shrimp. The side salads with ranch was great as well! Curbside pickup with a friendly smile:)
Very delicious! And the valet parking had my car cooled down with a cold bottle of water. This is a top notch place!

Ordered four items and only two made it to my house (uber eats delivery). Two burgers, popcorn chicken and onion rings. The two burgers weren't in the bag. The bag was stapled, so I couldn't blame the driver. Oh and there was a hair in my onion rings.

Why advertise delivery service when you immediately cancel delivery orders? If the service is available during certain hours, you should post that on your website so people see that as they prepare to order. I usually have no issues with Cheddars. I've left great reviews before. The food has always been delicious and doesn't break the bank. This experience however was a huge disappointment. I've got two hungry teens that thought they were getting Cheddars tonight. Plus, delivery would have been a treat for me when I've got to work late. Do better Cheddars.

The food is good, decent prices, and they are not stingy with their serving size.

Update: do not order on their website. They gave us cold kids chicken alfredo, cold cheese dip with no beef so we were charged extra for nothing twice due to double ordering, the salad was hot, the garlic bread looked like it sat outside for a year with nasty stuff on the bottom and you could literally throw it through a window and the window would break. The broccoli was raw, and the chicken strips were cold and rubbery.

One bad server can ruin an entire experience. She was rude and nasty from the moment we sat down. She damn near threw the appetizer down on the table. Then she put the wrong food in for my husband and handled that terribly. The steak was like shoe leather. It was so tough it was awful. The mistake and the steak both would have been overlooked had her attitude been better but nope! So unfortunately her tip reflected her attitude 🤷‍♀️

Went through the website and ordered over $100  in food and drinks..drinks were watered down a lot and food was extremely greasy and they didn't give us some sides and dessert..called and spoke to someone who said they will look into it and send me email by cob so far nothing has been received but we will see

We took out daughter and her husband for a celebratory birthday dinner on a Sunday at 5pm. From the first moment with the valet and the hosts at the door, we were greeted warmly. When we were taken to our table, we met our server, Jackson. Let me just say, I want him as our server every time! He made our time with him and each other so special! I would think, "He must've thought we were VIP's", but I think he is just a warm and thoughtful person.

As the cherry on top, the food and drinks were excellent! The service, obviously was impeccable 👌

OMG, the service was beyond excellent. Our waiter Bacari was the absolute best as well as the other wait staff. We did not want for anything. They kept the water flowing, the drinks and wind going. We didn't have to ask for much. The appetizers and food were on point. Great presentation and preparation. Bacari made sure our table was cleaned and silverware was replaced after each course. Just an overall fantastic experience

Everything was amazing except the access,.. you either have to pay for parking or use any public transportation.
Other than this, it was a great experience staff was nice and friendly as well as the service/food.
First time dining at this location. Great service and atmosphere. Parking can be a challenge.
Great place to eat and enjoy the ambience w friends. Great drinks too. Valet service is very good.

What an unfortunate lunch experience. The appetizer never arrived. The pasta was cold. I ordered a second Margarita and it never came. I shared my experience with the manager with no acknowledgement, no apology...nothing. General management, please take a good look, at this location.

Food was amazing!  The filet was on point and delicious!!   Unbelievable wine list, great selection.   Service was over the top good.  U definitely get what u pay for here and can’t wait to go back!!!   Tip:  If u valet park your car which I recommend because it’s so close that way.  you can get your ticket validated in the restaurant so it’s free.

We celebrated our 37th wedding anniversary. Excellent service from Ken. Drinks were excellent, the best Negroni in the Twin Cites. Staff is always friendly from the valets, to the hosts to the servers. Can’t wait to come back for our next diner.
From the Valet, Hostess, Server, “ Stephon” was Superb !!  Food {Steaks} & Sides were all on point !! Birthday Guest was all smiles and satisfied.  Thank you !!

Absolutely phenomenal. Friendly service from the valet, wait staff, host, everyone.  A cigar dinner, outside patio w water views. Premium smokes, well curated wines, prix fixe menu, very delicious and well presented. Kudos all around

Love this place and good food and amazing food and people
They got your parking don’t worried about that!

A high-end steakhouse located in Dunwoody.
Situated next to Primer Mall, parking is a breeze.
It seems to incorporate more unique flavors than the typical steak, like using 15-year-old balsamic vinegar as a sauce or adding shallot butter to dry-aged steak.
Of course, I also remember steaks from H&M and Pampas.
The interior was stylish, and the staff was friendly.
The seafood platter was fresh, and the fried calamari was delicious and not salty.
The cheesecake and chocolate cake served for dessert were also delicious.

The Capital Grille delivered a polished dining experience from start to finish. The service was professional, attentive, and well-paced. Our server was knowledgeable and made great recommendations.

The food lived up to the reputation — steaks were perfectly cooked, sides were rich and flavorful, and the appetizers were top quality. The lobster mac and the bone-in ribeye stood out.

The atmosphere was upscale but still comfortable. Great for a special occasion or a night out without kids. Price reflects the quality, and it’s worth it.

We’ll definitely be returning when we’re back in the area.

Good food, PHENOMENAL service.

**UPDATE**
Ask for John C. to be your waiter.  Made my birthday dinner even better, super attentive and an absolute pleasure!

ONLY problem and the reason I didn't give it 5 stars is the ridiculous $8 fee for valet parking.  Are bill for three people this evening what's $500 with a tip.  To charge for valet parking is ridiculous in my opinion.

Very simple, show a receipt did you paid your bill within the last 30 minutes and it should be free.  No receipt, hell charge $20.

An extremely pleasant early dinner. We only had time for the appetizer (calamari, and the caesar salad plus a cocktail) since we were going to a performance nearby very soon. Bottom line: we'll be back - very soon! The service and atmosphere was the best we've seen lately, and we do tend to go to restaurants where the food and service usually ranks pretty high. Our suggestion: go there. Plan on being there for a while. Enjoy!

Some of the dishes were not clean.  Food was OK but not worth the price.  Customer service was pretty good, but seems like the waiter got lost after he took our order.  I think the Chesterfield location has better quality food and slightly better customer service.  Downtown has a better ambiance setting. Also watch the valet guys at the downtown location.  Kid tried to charge me $200 at first to park my truck lol.  Must've thought I was slow.  It only cost $6 once you get your ticket stamped at the front desk of the restaurant.

I looked at the menu online and I was excited to see how good it be for my first visit. They have some great options, but honestly the appetizers were better than the dinner. They cooked my rib eye medium well when I asked for medium rare which wouldn't be that big a deal to me if they didn't charge so much. I am okay with paying top dollar, but I expect a top dollar experience when I do and this just wasn't that. Decent, but not worth the expense.
Great dinner as always. Love that valet parking. Chris was an excellent server.
Amazing food, amazing service. Our server was the nicest server ever. His recommendations were the ones I had and from the appetizers, to the entree and the desert A+.

This has to be one of the worst Cheddars I have been too. The waiter so slow, always going by but not asking if we needed refills laking lots of personal skills. The food was not great lacking flavor,my friend sent her food back because the first meal was so hard and not tasty at all. When we arrived the parking lot was empty, now I know why. I have been to other Cheddars and the food was great. This one lacks in everything. And Im visiting from out of town, and my friends first experience after me saying how wonderful it was. Smh!

I was expecting more with the Buffalo shrimp. It was just the fried shrimp then they sprinkled Buffalo sauce over it. Nothing fancy. I was comparing to some I got in New Jersey. Maybe I shouldn't have. Plus there was only 5 to an order of the appetizer.

No thanks! Just by looking at pictures of the food posted on their website, and the reviews about the food, I'd rather eat at Dakota's in my hometown of Tyler Texas! So if any of you are ever in Tyler Texas, try Dakota's!❤️

First time to this location. As usual did not disappoint at all!! Our waiter was great.  I couldn't eat all so much food!! The Berkshire Pork Chop out of this world good and super moist!  The appetizer Veal Osso Buco Ravioli amazing!
Luke and the manager, serving assistant and bartender were exceptional in making our night a true delight. The appetizers entree and desserts were all top notch. Flawless execution and presentation.
Long wait for a online order. Despite app saying order was complete still waited 15 mins once arriving for food that was just ok.  Venue seemed ok

Kevin & Brian are all right with me. Very happy that I went to the Crystal City location. Food and service was great, straight up. The view and atmosphere topped off the experience of the evening. Parking was free on Saturday evening. Highly recommend!

Our first time to Ruth's Chris Steakhouse.  The server Johnny was amazing, spot on and kind!  The apps, food, drinks were great! Food was hot and steaks were cooked as ordered.  Price was what we expected.
Have ordered to go here many times. Food is always excellent, friendly service at curbside, and priced right! Will always be a go to when I’m in town.

It was a private lunch for my daughter's Ph.D. graduation. Our first dining experience was everything I asked for and then some. The extra touches were wonderful. Kudos to Jason and his team. They were the best. Jason made us all feel very comfortable. Thanks to Robert Kier Jr. for his management, website navigation, instructions, and handling a plethora of questions. And thanks to Greg for getting the ball rolling. The family is still talking about our lunch event. Thanks again for the awesome effort to make our day special. The Capital Grille will be our first choice for future events.

The lamb chops were exquisite!! Cooked exactly like I want, and like it. I would have given food 5 stars, but did not enjoy the apple tarte dessert and the asparagus, could have been seasoned a little more. It was Valentine's Day, and kudos to the idea of passing out long stem single roses to all the women, which gave  a nice touch for couples. Thank you Matt the server for taking photos, pleasant guy.

So I ordered on uber eats and got the sliders I took a couple bites and thought it tasted off. I opened the burger and this is what I found.  I kid you not I was in the bathroom for an hour after that.  At least uber eats gave me a full refund but this is unacceptable.  There’s not even an option on how you’d like the burger cooked. Please make this right.

I’m used to the one in Rockville Center I tried to go to this one while I was in Astoria visiting a friend but unable to find parking I ended up going to the one in Rockville Cemter instead since they have a parking lot!

We began our dining experience at the bartop during happy hour around 4pm. The appetizer recommend was steak tips w onions and bread. My hubs said it was delicious.
We were ready for dinner at 5. They out rose petals on our table. The salmon over Indiana corn was perfect w spinich and the salad. Steve got a ribeye and a steak salad. The anniversary gift was 2 carrot cupcakes. We also order your cheesecake w raspberry  sauce & coffee. The presentation was perfect. It was a wonderful dining experience. The 100$ gift card from our kids made it even better.

Don't do much fine dining to compare,  but everything about this place was fantastic; the drinks, the appetizer, the sides, the entrée and dessert. I also have to mention the impeccable service. Jaden was phenomenal.

Being there twice, still not quite happy with the food and service.  I don’t think I can give them another chance, beside prices are higher and quality and service are lacking. Valet parking for 15 used  was the best highlight of my outing.
Came for our Anniversary and it was excellent. Food was great our waiter Kenny was fantastic. Only downer is just a bit pricey! My wife and I and 11 year old daughter..$300+ plus $15  to valet..
The food and the wine are the best. I love the location, and parking is easy. This is my favorite steak house. The staff was great.
Great Burger Spot. Has a great menu, many options to choose from. On the pricy side but it’s great ! Great location and plenty of parking.

Always a treat to eat here. Entrees are prepared perfectly. This one is located above the Tennessee River,  so nice views. Free parking and a decent happy hour.

Not good for vegetarians.
Their menu is incorrect so when I ordered from Uber Eats I got something I couldn't eat and it just went to waste. That was alot of money to waste.

I love Ruth's Chris Ironworks. First of all, way better than the downtown location where parking can be over $50. Also, the northside location has my favorite peanut butter and chocolate dessert. This location's decor is beautiful, and they have complimentary valet, delicious food, and friendly servers which is why this is one of my favorite restaurants. Their bread, mashed potatoes, and sweet potato casserole in addition to their amazing filets are the reasons I'll keep coming back.
Food and service was great as always. The waiter and staff were so professional and made our special night out just perfect! Just wish they still had the apple pie dessert. We really miss that.
Food and service was great as always. The waiter and staff were so professional and made our special night out just perfect! Just wish they still had the apple pie dessert. We really miss that.
Takes a million years for curbside pickup and the system is absolute garbage.

We had a truly exceptional experience at the restaurant, starting from the warm greeting by the valet to our departure. Our waitress provided exemplary service, attending to all our needs with great care. The manager also took the time to visit our table, ensuring that our meals were prepared to our satisfaction. Overall, our dining experience was marvelous, and the food was impeccably cooked. If you are in search of a delightful meal accompanied by outstanding service, we highly recommend visiting Ruth's Chris Steak House!

We had a truly exceptional experience at the restaurant, starting from the warm greeting by the valet to our departure. Our waitress provided exemplary service, attending to all our needs with great care. The manager also took the time to visit our table, ensuring that our meals were prepared to our satisfaction. Overall, our dining experience was marvelous, and the food was impeccably cooked. If you are in search of a delightful meal accompanied by outstanding service, we highly recommend visiting Ruth's Chris Steak House!

I love Cheddars but had never been to Cheddars @ Alliance. Maybe it was a bad night.  I ordered something simple.  Chicken tenders.   My order was curbside.  Service was excellent but the food had no flavor other than grease.  I'll try them again and order what I normally get which is is the grilled chicken pecan salad. I'm expecting greatness!

Was being treated to a Birthday dinner here. my first time coming and it did not dissappoint. We had the 3 course for 60 deal, a very good deal. Our server was awesome. The food was perfectly delicious and plenty. I will definately return.
the only negative thing for me would be parking. there is valet but for those who dont want valet depending on the time and day you may have to circle or park further down the strip. i would also recommend making a reservation.

First time here and place was great had no issues found parking pretty easy and made reservations online we came 30 mins early and table was already ready for us Alex our server was great and very friendly as for the food it was great no complaints from any one in my group we definitely enjoyed it and would recommend to anyone also it’s kid friendly they do have high chairs as well as kid friendly food just have to ask

Love their Blackened Salmon and the Dijon Chicken & Mushrooms.
It was easy to find a gluten-free and dairy-free option(s) on the website.
An unvarying menu of well executed steaks and simple sides in a casually elegant setting with efficient service and decent wines. Parking is less than convenient although free.

We celebrated my sister-in-law's birthday with you last evening. The experience was exquisite from start to finish: booking the reservation, quick and respectful valet service, the relaxing atmosphere, attentive service from Josh our friendly, professional waiter (who was great with our two kids by the way) and Rachel the manager, mouth-watering flavors and an excellent wine selection! Can't wait to come back for our next special occasion!

We celebrated my sister-in-law's birthday with you last evening. The experience was exquisite from start to finish: booking the reservation, quick and respectful valet service, the relaxing atmosphere, attentive service from Josh our friendly, professional waiter (who was great with our two kids by the way) and Rachel the manager, mouth-watering flavors and an excellent wine selection! Can't wait to come back for our next special occasion!

The Capital Grille is posh. The Crab & Lobster Cake is excellent. The bread is also something special. They need to upgrade their bar menu, but they have excellent bar options. They have a private parking lot, or they will valet.

I’ve ordered before and it’s been good.  But this is the salad I ordered today - I don’t understand how they can let this type of lettuce go out the door- who would eat this?  They also added tomato to sandwich when I specifically asked it to be left out due to allergies.   After 15 minutes of looking for parking, this is what I got.  The manager didn’t even apologize when I called, she just said - i’ve seen other salads today and they were fine.  Not this one!

This knocked one of our favorites out of the top 5. This was such an extraordinary evening. The food, ambience, and service were second-to-none. Everything from the appetizers to the dessert was exquisite!!!! The au gratin potatoes would be a starter on a lesser team, but next to the mashed potatoes, it was Scottie Pippen.

Great food, we ordered pickup because the wait on the inside was horrible, stood for 10 minutes without anyone even showing up to seat the people in front of us and it wasn't that busy inside. The parking lot was a bit dirty, the front door was clearly broken, they were out of certain types of drinks. The food we got was amazing and just like their tag line was made from scratch. Even the chips you could tell were made in house. I would highly recommend picking up a dinner from here as it is really good food, the inside though needs some work with the staff and the maintenance.
Order take out from here, food is good, service on time, parking available.

Awesome place! We were invited to a birthday party here. We had filet mignon with mash potatoes- truly the most delicious steak we’ve ever tried. Excellent servers too. They had valet parking which made our lives easy!
You can’t go wrong with any type of steak you get. The calamari is exceptionally good. The only downside is finding parking.
Overall experience was very good. Staff is professional and service is almost tailored.  Valet available for parking on-site or self-park about 2 minutes walk away.

I was an hour late because I was stuck in traffic. My wife called and talked to the young male manager and they refired our food fresh with a smile. The curbside young lady was very courteous and respectful. This is me and my family's favorite place. Thank you guys for going above and beyond.

Hansen Harper
The food and service were excellent. The valet was fairly quick. I only down greatest store because they don’t have any vegetarian options and the Mocktail menu was very limited.
The food delicious. Dom was the absolute best server!! My only complaint is valet is $15 now. As much money as you're spending valet should be free.

Great place for lunch or dinner.  The atmosphere is old DC with dark wood, long wrap around bar with indoor and out door seating.
They specialize in Scotch, but have a wealth of other drinks including specialty cocktails.
The appetizers are generous and can easily serve as a lunch.  The salads are the same.  I had their Bacon Cheeseburger with the tomato jam that was really flavorful, tender and well prepared.  It came with well salted fries.
This is now my goto for lunches on my occasional trips to my DC office.

If you’re debating on coming here, go! It’s an excellent fine dining option if you’re looking for a sophisticated ambiance and selection. Food was superb, we did not feel rushed despite being there towards closing hours on a Saturday, and I received complimentary birthday champagne, card, and dessert. Staff were patient and kind, the appetizers were great portions, and the drinks were made to perfection.

Loved eating here! The appetizers were so good, and my steak was cooked perfectly. The salmon and sea bass were both amazing, and the desserts were delicious.
Fabier, our server, was super cool and helped me a lot with my cocktail choices — his recommendations were great. The manager, Christian, also stopped by to make sure everything was good, which I really appreciated.
Definitely coming back!

I will say, Capital Grill is one of our favorite steak houses. Food is always perfection. You won’t find a better steak anywhere. Service is impeccable. The one thing that I find incredibly annoying, is after spending well over a thousand dollars on dinner for 5 people, they don’t validate parking. Which is 12.00!! It won’t stop us from going back, but how insane,  and kinda
“ classless” is that. 🤷🏻

They sat is right next to their curbside/ delivery door in the bar. When it was chilly. And the restaurant was not busy. Bartender was our waitress. Ordered a strawberry lemonade and appetizer. Drink came and it was EXTREMELY SOUR and the berries weren't fresh. Tried to add a Splenda to it to help but 2 wasn't enough.

Very succulent burger, especially with the no bun one. I like their location and atmosphere. It’s not cheap but highly recommended (their burger meat quality probably is better than the BBP in the Bergen Town Center). They accept the Chase Pay and if you use the app to order ahead, they automatically enroll you into their loyalty program and give you $10 for every $100 purchased. They also give you $20 credits for your enrollment anniversary. Nice!!
